username_note: SIG-2 (Create and secure the X account) is the blocker. Every pull script fails closed until username is set here.
cadence_note: Target only. Volume is the LAST lever, never the first. Under-shipping is the most common cause of a bad week, but volume on a bad premise burns credibility and cadence at the same time.

measurement_windows.rule: Every post metric is read at exactly one of these two offsets. Never compare a T+24h number to a T+7d number. The format scoreboard is computed on T+24h only until a format has 20+ posts, at which point it may also be reported on T+7d.

kill_rule.impression_guard: UNSATISFIED_AT_BASELINE. A format cannot be killed on the 5-post rule alone until its arm also clears the impression floor in noise_floor.json for the effect size being claimed. See SCHEMA.md 'Kill rule, with the guard the skill does not state'.

data_source_note: X API v2. Public metrics (impressions, likes, reposts, replies, quotes, bookmarks) need an app-only Bearer token. non_public_metrics (profile clicks, URL clicks, engagements) and the per-follower event stream need OAuth user context. See scripts/pull_x_metrics.py and README.md 'What needs a credential'.
